entries.5296f5cc669e59e4: Its basic policy is to make appropriate investments to cultivate "earning power" and to create "brand" value as a manufacturer. For woodworking machines, it says it is advancing technology development that responds to changes in customer needs, such as digitalization and labor-saving, and research related to expanding the use of domestically grown timber; for machine tools, it says it is pursuing capital investment demand for automation and labor-saving, and the potential for use in advanced technology fields such as AI. It also says it is working on the introduction of new equipment, digital investment and the development of overseas sales markets.

entries.7dd837d3aa3a7e29: Since its founding in 1897, the company has continued to make sawmill and woodworking machines, and it has development achievements dating from its early days, including the first domestically produced sawmill machine and the automatic four-sided planer, the first of its kind developed in Japan.
